description: This file defines API endpoints for managing a shopping cart in a web application using FastAPI. It includes handlers for retrieving, adding, updating, removing, and clearing cart items, utilizing dependency injection for database sessions and user authentication.

methods.description: Adds a product to the cart or updates its quantity.

methods.name: update_quantity(product_id: int, payload: CartItemUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a specific product in the cart.

methods.name: remove_item(product_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Removes a specified product from the cart.

methods.name: clear_cart(db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Clears all items from the user's cart.
